title: AdverMCTS: Combating Pseudo-Correctness in Code Generation via Adversarial Monte Carlo Tree Search
authors_zh: Qingyao Li、Weiwen Liu、Weinan Zhang、Yong Yu、Bo An
paper_type_zh: 对抗式测试时搜索、动态验证器与代码选择方法
best_for_zh: 研究代码推理、MCTS、反例生成、动态验证器和验证器审计的读者
one_line: AdverMCTS co-evolves a Solver code-search tree and an Attacker test-search tree, retaining Arbiter-labeled counterexamples as a growing hard verifier at inference time.
AdverMCTS 让 Solver 代码树与 Attacker 测试树共同演化，并把同一主干模型的 Arbiter 标注反例存为逐题动态硬验证器；但 79.88% 测试有效率与 16.1% 误杀率表明，持久约束仍可能被错误标签污染。
why: It turns adversarial counterexample discovery into an explicit inference-time data pipeline, while making clear that test validity, sandboxing, retention policy, decision lineage and release completeness determine whether the resulting verifier can be trusted or reused.
inclusion_reason: AdverMCTS is a concrete test-time data-construction recipe in which an adversarial search agent generates and retains counterexample tests that continuously strengthen a code verifier, while its measured Arbiter errors and incomplete trace release expose important audit risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
AdverMCTS targets pseudo-correctness in competitive-programming generation: a program can satisfy a few visible examples while still failing hidden cases. The paper treats this as a verifier problem at inference time. Instead of accepting the visible-test signal as fixed, it lets a Solver propose programs and an Attacker construct counterexample tests against the current candidates.

The operative data object is not a released static dataset. For each APPS or TACO problem, the run transiently creates a Solver thought tree, complete Python programs, public-test results, an accepted code pool, an Attacker strategy tree, candidate inputs, per-program outputs, divergence scores, Arbiter decisions and expected outputs, and a growing memory of accepted adversarial tests. The memory is local to the problem and gates later candidates. The final answer is a program selected by public-test score and then adversarial-test score; hidden tests remain evaluation-only.

This makes the paper relevant to data_construction_open_release_recipes: it specifies a concrete recipe for generating and retaining verifier data during search. The qualification matters, however. The official repository releases implementation code, not the generated search traces, counterexample tests, code pools, or per-test decision ledger. The Card therefore records a reproducible research recipe only partially, not an open training corpus.

The official evidence set is the ICML 2026 OpenReview record, arXiv:2604.10449 (including its appendices and prompts), and the repository linked by OpenReview, inspected at commit f45427800a32dc6966429bc4f7baf61df5c6a15f. OpenReview identifies the paper as an ICML 2026 regular paper and lists the two affiliations recorded in this Card. Unknown release facts remain unknown rather than inferred.

AdverMCTS 处理竞赛编程生成中的伪正确性：程序可能通过少量可见样例，却仍在隐藏测试上失败。论文把它视为推理阶段的验证器问题。方法不把可见测试信号当作固定终点，而是让 Solver 提出程序，再由 Attacker 针对当前候选构造反例测试。

这里真正运行的数据对象不是一个已发布的静态数据集。对每道 APPS 或 TACO 题目，系统临时产生 Solver 思维树、完整 Python 程序、公开测试结果、已接纳代码池、Attacker 策略树、候选输入、各程序输出、分歧分数、Arbiter 判定与期望输出，以及持续增长的已接纳对抗测试记忆。该记忆只在当前题目内有效，并约束后续候选。最终答案先按公开测试得分、再按对抗测试得分选择；隐藏测试仅用于评测。

因此，该论文适合 data_construction_open_release_recipes：它给出了在搜索过程中生成并保留验证器数据的具体配方。但需要明确边界：官方仓库发布的是实现代码，而不是生成的搜索轨迹、反例测试、代码池或逐测试决策账本。因此本 Card 记录的是仅部分可复现的研究配方，而不是开放训练语料。

官方证据集包括 ICML 2026 OpenReview 记录、arXiv:2604.10449 的正文与附录/提示词，以及 OpenReview 链接的官方仓库；代码核验到提交 f45427800a32dc6966429bc4f7baf61df5c6a15f。OpenReview 将其标为 ICML 2026 regular paper，论文首页也支持本 Card 记录的两家机构。无法确认的发布事实保持 unknown，不作推断。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
AdverMCTS couples two persistent Monte Carlo tree searches through a shared, problem-local test memory.

| Component | Produces | Feedback it receives | Effect on later search | |---|---|---|---| | Solver MCTS | partial reasoning thoughts and complete Python programs | public-test pass rate; penalties for failing retained adversarial tests | only programs passing all visible and retained tests may enter the code pool | | Attacker MCTS | vulnerability strategies and concrete test inputs | output divergence among programs in the current code pool | searches for inputs that separate apparently correct programs | | LLM output Arbiter | a validity judgment and expected output for a divergent input | problem statement, candidate input, and divergent program outputs | accepted (input, expected_output) pairs enter global test memory | | Execution environment | outputs, failures, timeouts, and pass/fail signals | generated programs and public/adversarial inputs | supplies the observable evidence used by all three roles | | Final reranker | one submitted program | public-test score first, accumulated adversarial-test score second | uses retained tests as a hard secondary discriminator |

The same selected backbone family is reused as Solver, Attacker, and Arbiter; there is no separately trained verifier or independent teacher. The important feedback contract is therefore mixed: executable tests provide objective observations, divergence is only a heuristic search reward, and the expected output is supplied by an LLM judge. A retained test becomes a persistent hard constraint even though its label may be wrong.

Compared with MCTS-Thought and RethinkMCTS, the central change is that verification evidence evolves with the candidate pool rather than remaining a fixed set of public tests. Compared with CodeT-style test generation, the method organizes test construction as a persistent adversarial search and feeds accepted tests back into subsequent Solver expansion. These are methodological comparisons from the paper, not evidence that the produced tests form a higher-quality reusable dataset.

The verifier cannot observe hidden-test correctness. It can also miss a shared bug when every pooled program returns the same wrong output, because output divergence is then zero. The paper states this limitation explicitly.

AdverMCTS 通过逐题共享的测试记忆，把两个持久化 Monte Carlo tree search 耦合起来。

| 组件 | 产物 | 接收的反馈 | 对后续搜索的作用 | |---|---|---|---| | Solver MCTS | 局部推理思路与完整 Python 程序 | 公开测试通过率；未通过已保留对抗测试时的惩罚 | 只有通过全部可见测试与既有对抗测试的程序才能进入代码池 | | Attacker MCTS | 漏洞策略与具体测试输入 | 当前代码池中程序输出的分歧 | 搜索能够区分表面正确程序的输入 | | LLM output Arbiter | 对分歧输入的有效性判断与期望输出 | 题目描述、候选输入和各程序的分歧输出 | 被接纳的 (input, expected_output) 进入全局测试记忆 | | 执行环境 | 输出、失败、超时与通过/失败信号 | 生成程序以及公开/对抗输入 | 提供三类角色共同使用的可观察证据 | | 最终重排器 | 一个提交程序 | 先比较公开测试得分，再比较累计对抗测试得分 | 以保留测试作为硬性的第二层判别依据 |

同一个所选主干模型家族同时担任 Solver、Attacker 与 Arbiter；系统没有单独训练的验证器或独立教师。因此关键反馈契约是混合型：可执行测试给出客观观测，分歧只是搜索启发式奖励，期望输出则来自 LLM judge。即使标签可能错误，一旦测试被保留，它仍会成为持久的硬约束。

相较 MCTS-Thought 与 RethinkMCTS，关键变化是验证证据随候选代码池演化，而不是固定为少量公开测试。相较 CodeT 式测试生成，该方法把测试构造组织成持久的对抗搜索，并把接纳的测试反馈给后续 Solver 扩展。这些是论文中的方法对比，不能据此证明所产测试已经构成质量更高的可复用数据集。

验证器看不到隐藏测试上的真实正确性。如果代码池里的所有程序共享同一错误并输出相同错误答案，输出分歧为零，验证器也无法发现它；论文明确指出了这一限制。

title: Method
方法
html:
For each problem, the method proceeds as follows.

  1. Initialize a persistent Solver MCTS from the problem statement and visible public tests. Expanded nodes are partial chain-of-thought continuations; rollouts produce complete Python programs.
  2. Execute each program on public tests. Public-test pass rate is the intrinsic Solver reward. A program enters the shared code pool only if it passes every public test and every adversarial test retained so far.
  3. Run the persistent Attacker MCTS conditioned on the current code pool. An Attacker node represents a testing strategy. Divergence-driven multi-sample test synthesis generates a batch of candidate inputs, executes all pooled programs, and selects the input with the greatest output disagreement.
  4. Send a divergent input, the specification, and the competing outputs to the same-backbone LLM output Arbiter. If the Arbiter considers the test ambiguous or invalid, discard it. Otherwise retain the Arbiter's expected output as an adversarial test.
  5. Append the accepted pair to problem-local dynamic test memory. Recheck pool admission, penalize Solver nodes whose programs fail the test, and continue the alternating searches.
  6. At the end, rank programs hierarchically by public-test pass rate and then by pass rate across all retained adversarial tests. Hidden tests are used only to report Pass@1.

The main experiments sample 100 problems from each of APPS Introductory, Interview, and Competition and TACO Easy, Medium, and Hard: 600 problems total, with at most five visible public tests per problem. Main settings are 16 Solver rollouts, 2 Attacker rollouts, maximum tree width 3, Solver UCB coefficient 4, and penalty value 0.1. The paper evaluates Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-8B, with a DeepSeek-V3.2 671B scaling experiment. It reports vLLM execution but does not disclose a complete hardware, token, wall-clock, or dollar-cost contract.

The official repository README recommends --rollout 16 --attacker_rollout 2. At inspected commit f45427800a32dc6966429bc4f7baf61df5c6a15f, the driver defaults include tree width 3, code-pool size 2, divergence threshold 0.2, five candidate tests per synthesis batch, and seed 0; the implementation uses temperature 0.7 for test-input sampling and 0.0 for Arbiter calls. Some class-level fallbacks differ, so the command-line configuration should be logged rather than reconstructed from one source file. The paper does not disclose numerical values for every algorithm symbol, and the exact paper-version configuration is therefore partly unknown.

The released executor combines an 11-second in-process alarm with a 15-second parent monitor, a 10 MB captured-output limit, 4 GiB address/data/stack limits, and guards against selected destructive or process operations. These controls improve reliability, but the inspected repository provides no container, namespace, seccomp, or documented network isolation. It should not be treated as a security sandbox for arbitrary untrusted programs.

对每道题，方法按以下流程运行。

  1. 根据题目描述和可见公开测试初始化持久化 Solver MCTS。扩展节点是局部 chain-of-thought 延续，rollout 生成完整 Python 程序。
  2. 在公开测试上执行每个程序。公开测试通过率提供 Solver 的内在奖励。只有通过全部公开测试与截至当时所有对抗测试的程序，才能进入共享代码池。
  3. 运行以当前代码池为条件的持久化 Attacker MCTS。Attacker 节点表示测试策略。divergence-driven multi-sample test synthesis 批量生成候选输入，在所有池内程序上执行，并选择输出分歧最大的输入。
  4. 将分歧输入、题目规格与竞争输出送给同主干 LLM output Arbiter。若 Arbiter 认为测试含糊或无效，则丢弃；否则把 Arbiter 给出的期望输出保留为对抗测试。
  5. 将被接纳的输入—输出对加入逐题动态测试记忆，重新检查代码池准入，对未通过该测试的 Solver 节点施加惩罚，然后继续交替搜索。
  6. 结束时先按公开测试通过率、再按全部保留对抗测试的通过率分层排序程序。隐藏测试只用于报告 Pass@1。

主实验从 APPS Introductory、Interview、Competition 与 TACO Easy、Medium、Hard 六个划分各抽取 100 题，共 600 题，每题最多提供五个可见公开测试。主要设置为 16 次 Solver rollout、2 次 Attacker rollout、最大树宽 3、Solver UCB 系数 4、惩罚值 0.1。论文评测 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 与 Qwen3-8B，并用 DeepSeek-V3.2 671B 做主干扩展实验。论文说明使用 vLLM，但没有完整披露硬件、token、墙钟时间或美元成本契约。

官方仓库 README 推荐 --rollout 16 --attacker_rollout 2。在核验提交 f45427800a32dc6966429bc4f7baf61df5c6a15f 中，驱动程序默认值包括树宽 3、代码池大小 2、分歧阈值 0.2、每批五个候选测试以及随机种子 0；实现对测试输入采样使用温度 0.7，对 Arbiter 调用使用 0.0。部分 class-level fallback 与命令行默认值不同，因此复现时应直接记录命令行配置，不能只从某个源文件重建。论文没有给出算法中每个符号的数值，精确论文版本配置仍有部分 unknown。

发布的执行器结合了 11 秒进程内 alarm、15 秒父进程监控、10 MB 捕获输出上限、4 GiB 地址/数据/栈限制，以及对部分破坏性操作和进程操作的拦截。这些措施提高可靠性，但仓库没有提供容器、namespace、seccomp 或有文档说明的网络隔离，不能把它当成执行任意不可信程序的安全沙箱。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The evidence supports an inference-time search improvement and also exposes verifier error; it does not establish that the transient counterexamples are a clean reusable dataset.

| Evidence | Reported result | What it supports | Boundary | |---|---|---|---| | Table 1, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 | AdverMCTS averages 49.67 Pass@1 on APPS and 38.00 on TACO, versus 43.44/31.00 for MCTS-Thought and 43.67/33.67 for RethinkMCTS | the full method improves final program selection under the reported setup | benchmark performance is not a direct measure of test-label quality | | Figure 4 ablation | Full method reaches 49.7/38.0; removing the Attacker tree gives 43.3/31.0, removing divergence-driven synthesis 46.0/33.7, and removing the Global Filtering Hub 48.3/35.3 | each named component contributes under the controlled budget | it does not isolate every interaction or externalize the generated records | | Table 3, TACO gold-code check | Arbiter-labeled tests are valid 79.88% of the time, versus 37.88% for majority voting; downstream Pass@1 is 49.67/37.33 versus 43.67/32.67 | the Arbiter is a better labeler than the tested voting baseline | roughly one fifth of tested Arbiter labels still fail gold-code validation | | Figure 7, discriminator audit | 165 of 291 pseudo-correct programs are killed: 56.7% recall and 78.95% precision; 44 truly correct programs are mis-killed, a 16.1% false-positive rate | retained tests detect many silent bugs but also poison some decisions | substantial false negatives and false positives remain | | Appendix C.1 oracle-test study | Giving MCTS-Thought half of the hidden tests raises average Pass@1 from 43.44 to 55.33 on APPS and 31.00 to 43.67 on TACO | weak visible verification is a limiting factor | hidden-test access is an oracle diagnostic, not a deployable method | | Appendix C.3 attacker budget | APPS Competition rises from 31% at one Attacker rollout to 36% at two; larger budgets can saturate or degrade | more adversarial search is not monotonically beneficial | exact cost-effectiveness remains unreported |

Table 2 further reports that removing Solver context, replacing Attacker MCTS with Best-of-N, or using Random-MCTS reduces the averages relative to the full method. Figure 5 reports that the 16-rollout method surpasses a 32-sample baseline with fewer tokens, but the plot does not supply a complete reproducible cost ledger, so this Card does not convert the claim into exact efficiency numbers.

All figures above are author-reported. The inspected repository contains implementation code but no immutable release, published result bundle, generated test set, exact sampled problem IDs, or independent reproduction. Consequently, evidence confidence is medium despite clear paper-level ablations.

证据支持推理阶段搜索改进，同时也暴露验证器错误；它没有证明这些临时反例已经是干净、可复用的数据集。

| 证据 | 报告结果 | 能支持什么 | 证据边界 | |---|---|---|---| | 表 1，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 | AdverMCTS 在 APPS/TACO 上平均 Pass@1 为 49.67/38.00；MCTS-Thought 为 43.44/31.00，RethinkMCTS 为 43.67/33.67 | 在报告设置下，完整方法改善最终程序选择 | benchmark 表现不是测试标签质量的直接度量 | | 图 4 消融 | 完整方法为 49.7/38.0；移除 Attacker tree 为 43.3/31.0，移除 divergence-driven synthesis 为 46.0/33.7，移除 Global Filtering Hub 为 48.3/35.3 | 在受控预算下，各命名组件都有贡献 | 没有隔离全部交互，也没有发布生成记录 | | 表 3，TACO gold-code 核验 | Arbiter 标注测试有效率为 79.88%，majority voting 为 37.88%；对应下游 Pass@1 为 49.67/37.33 与 43.67/32.67 | Arbiter 优于该投票基线 | 经 gold code 检查的 Arbiter 标签仍约有五分之一无效 | | 图 7，判别审计 | 291 个伪正确程序中杀死 165 个：recall 56.7%、precision 78.95%；同时误杀 44 个正确程序，false-positive rate 为 16.1% | 保留测试能发现不少静默错误，也会污染部分决策 | 仍存在大量 false negative 与 false positive | | 附录 C.1，oracle 测试实验 | 向 MCTS-Thought 提供一半隐藏测试后，APPS 平均 Pass@1 从 43.44 升至 55.33，TACO 从 31.00 升至 43.67 | 弱可见验证确实是瓶颈 | 使用隐藏测试是 oracle 诊断，不是可部署方法 | | 附录 C.3，Attacker 预算 | APPS Competition 从 1 次 Attacker rollout 的 31% 升至 2 次的 36%；继续增加可能饱和或下降 | 增加对抗搜索并非单调有益 | 精确成本效益仍未报告 |

表 2 还报告：移除 Solver 上下文、把 Attacker MCTS 换成 Best-of-N，或使用 Random-MCTS，平均结果均低于完整方法。图 5 报告 16-rollout 的方法以较少 token 超过 32-sample 基线，但图中没有给出完整、可复现的成本账本，因此本 Card 不把该结论转写为精确效率数字。

以上数字均为作者报告。核验到的仓库包含实现代码，却没有不可变 release、发布的结果包、生成测试集、精确抽样题目 ID 或独立复现。因此即使论文消融较完整，证据置信度仍为中。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper's main novelty is the closed-loop coupling of candidate generation and verifier-data construction at test time. Solver MCTS changes the candidate population; Attacker MCTS searches for inputs that expose disagreement in that population; an LLM Arbiter converts selected inputs into labeled tests; and those tests alter future Solver rewards, pool admission, and final ranking.

The individual ingredients are not new in isolation: Monte Carlo tree search, public-test execution, test generation, LLM judging, and candidate reranking all predate this work. The claimed contribution is their persistent adversarial co-evolution, including a global filtering memory that carries accepted counterexamples through the remainder of one problem. The paper's comparisons and ablations support the utility of that integration under its evaluation settings.

From a data-curation perspective, the distinctive object is an online stream of test proposals, divergent execution tuples, judge decisions, retained counterexamples, and downstream penalties. That stream could support verifier training or audit if released with lineage. It is currently transient: the repository does not publish it as a stable dataset, and the paper trains no new model on it. The contribution should therefore be described as a data-construction recipe and inference-time environment, not as an open dataset or a demonstrated post-training corpus.

论文的主要新意是：在测试时把候选生成与验证器数据构造做成闭环耦合。Solver MCTS 改变候选群体；Attacker MCTS 搜索能暴露该群体分歧的输入；LLM Arbiter 把选中的输入转为带标签测试；这些测试再改变后续 Solver 奖励、代码池准入和最终排序。

各个组成部分并非单独首次出现：Monte Carlo tree search、公开测试执行、测试生成、LLM judging 和候选重排都早于本工作。论文声称的贡献在于让它们持久地对抗共演化，包括一个在单道题剩余搜索期间持续保存已接纳反例的 global filtering memory。论文的对比与消融支持该集成在其评测设置下的效用。

从数据策展视角看，最有辨识度的数据对象是一条在线数据流：测试提议、分歧执行元组、judge 决策、保留反例和下游惩罚。如果连同 lineage 发布，该数据流可用于验证器训练或审计。但当前它只是瞬时过程：仓库没有把它发布为稳定数据集，论文也没有用它训练新模型。因此贡献应描述为数据构造配方与推理时环境，而不是开放数据集或已经验证的后训练语料。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The paper and official artifacts support the following limitations.

  • Shared-error blindness: divergence cannot expose a bug shared by every program in the current pool. This is stated explicitly in the method discussion.
  • Measured label error: against TACO gold code, the Arbiter's labeled tests are valid 79.88% of the time. In the discriminator analysis, recall is 56.7%, precision 78.95%, and the false-positive rate 16.1%; 44 correct programs are mis-killed.
  • Non-monotonic attack budget: the appendix reports an inverted-U trend from one to four Attacker rollouts and attributes degradation to brittle or borderline-valid tests.
  • Incomplete reproduction contract: exact sampled benchmark IDs, a full seed/configuration manifest, all decoding settings, hardware and cost accounting, dependency lockfile, and an immutable tagged release are unavailable.
  • No reusable generated-data release: search trees, generated programs, proposed and rejected tests, Arbiter rationales/labels, execution tuples, and the final retained test memory are not published.
  • License boundary: the paper is CC BY 4.0, but the inspected code repository has no explicit LICENSE, and APPS/TACO retain their own upstream terms. The paper license does not establish reuse rights for code, benchmark data, or generated outputs.
  • Execution boundary: time, memory, output, and selected-operation guards are present, but the code is not containerized or kernel-isolated and has no documented network isolation.

The following are curator inferences from the released implementation, not measured paper results. A wrong Arbiter label persists as a hard per-problem constraint, yet no explicit deduplication, confidence calibration, repeated independent validation, correction, or test retraction loop was found. No explicit repeated-execution screen was found, so nondeterministic programs or environments may create unstable divergence evidence. Reusing one backbone in all three roles can also correlate generator and judge errors; the paper does not compare against an independent oracle at deployment time.

Benchmark gains must not be read as proof of data quality. They combine search, filtering, and final selection effects, while the direct validity and discriminator audits document material errors in the verifier data itself.

论文与官方 artifacts 支持以下限制。

  • 共同错误盲区： 如果当前代码池里的所有程序共享同一错误，分歧无法揭示它；方法讨论明确说明了这一点。
  • 实测标签错误： 对照 TACO gold code，Arbiter 标注测试的有效率为 79.88%。判别分析中 recall 为 56.7%、precision 为 78.95%、false-positive rate 为 16.1%，并误杀了 44 个正确程序。
  • 攻击预算非单调： 附录报告 1 至 4 次 Attacker rollout 呈倒 U 型趋势，并把退化归因于脆弱或处在有效性边界的测试。
  • 复现契约不完整： 缺少精确抽样题目 ID、完整 seed/configuration manifest、全部解码设置、硬件与成本账目、依赖锁文件和不可变 tag release。
  • 没有可复用的生成数据发布： 搜索树、生成程序、候选与拒绝测试、Arbiter 理由/标签、执行元组和最终保留测试记忆均未发布。
  • 许可证边界： 论文使用 CC BY 4.0，但核验的代码仓库没有显式 LICENSE，APPS/TACO 也保留各自上游条款。论文许可证不能证明代码、benchmark 数据或生成输出可以复用。
  • 执行边界： 虽然具备时间、内存、输出及部分操作限制，但代码没有容器化或内核隔离，也没有文档化网络隔离。

以下是基于发布实现的策展者推断，不是论文测量结果。错误的 Arbiter 标签会作为当前题目的硬约束持续存在，但实现中没有发现显式去重、置信度校准、重复独立验证、纠错或测试撤回回路。也没有发现显式重复执行筛查，因此非确定性程序或环境可能制造不稳定的分歧证据。三个角色复用同一主干还可能让生成器与 judge 错误相关；论文没有在实际部署条件下与独立 oracle 对比。

不能把 benchmark 提升解读为数据质量证明。它混合了搜索、过滤与最终选择的作用，而直接有效性与判别审计已经记录了验证器数据中的实质错误。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data_construction_open_release_recipes track, AdverMCTS is useful as a blueprint for turning search-time disagreement into auditable verifier data. A strong reproduction should log, for every problem and test proposal: stable problem/test IDs, prompt and strategy path, code-pool snapshot, all execution outputs, divergence score, Arbiter input and decision, expected output, rejection reason, later revalidation results, and every penalty or ranking change. That would make the construction lineage inspectable and permit test-level precision, recall, duplication, and poisoning analyses.

The recipe is especially useful for research on dynamic verifiers, counterexample generation, test-time compute allocation, process supervision, and adversarial code-agent environments. Its rejected tests and false-positive cases could be as valuable as retained tests for training judge calibration or abstention systems. Those are prospective uses; the paper itself performs inference-time search and evaluation, not parameter training.

Practical reuse is conditional. The released code can inform a research reimplementation, but the missing license must be resolved before redistribution, APPS/TACO must be obtained under their own terms, and generated programs should run in a stronger sandbox. Exact reproduction also needs the sampled problem manifest, pinned dependencies, model/checkpoint identifiers, endpoint and decoding configuration, seeds, prompt versions, full cost records, and an immutable release.

A useful baseline release would pair the current method with independently executable gold validation, repeated execution for flakiness, deduplication, confidence/disagreement fields, and correction or retraction of invalid tests. Until such records are published, this Card should be used to study the recipe and its audit risks, not as evidence that a reusable AdverMCTS dataset is available.

对于 data_construction_open_release_recipes 轨道，AdverMCTS 的价值在于展示如何把搜索时分歧转为可审计的验证器数据。一个强复现应为每道题和每个测试提议记录：稳定的题目/测试 ID、prompt 与策略路径、代码池快照、全部执行输出、分歧分数、Arbiter 输入与决策、期望输出、拒绝原因、后续再验证结果，以及每次惩罚或排序变化。这样才能检查构造 lineage，并计算逐测试 precision、recall、重复率与污染风险。

该配方尤其适用于研究动态验证器、反例生成、测试时算力分配、过程监督与对抗式代码 agent 环境。被拒测试和 false-positive 案例也可用于训练 judge 校准或 abstention 系统。这些是潜在用途；论文本身做的是推理时搜索与评测，不是参数训练。

实际复用存在条件。发布代码可帮助研究性重实现，但重新分发前必须解决缺失许可证问题；APPS/TACO 需按各自条款获取；生成程序应放入更强的沙箱。精确复现还需要抽样题目清单、固定依赖、模型/checkpoint 标识、endpoint 与解码配置、随机种子、prompt 版本、完整成本记录和不可变 release。

一个有用的基线发布应在当前方法之上加入可独立执行的 gold 验证、用于发现 flakiness 的重复执行、去重、置信度/分歧字段，以及无效测试的纠正或撤回。在这些记录发布前，本 Card 适合用于研究该配方及其审计风险，不能作为已有可复用 AdverMCTS 数据集的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.3–3.6 together: the contribution is the feedback loop across Solver, Attacker, Arbiter, global test memory, and final reranking, not any component alone.
  • Keep the three signals separate: public-test pass rate is Solver reward, output divergence is Attacker reward, and the Arbiter supplies test validity plus expected output. None is equivalent to hidden-test correctness.
  • Table 1 establishes task-level gains; Table 3 and Figure 7 are more informative for verifier-data quality because they directly measure label validity and discrimination errors.
  • Appendix C.1 is an oracle diagnostic showing the cost of weak verification; Appendix C.3 shows that more Attacker compute can worsen results. Neither supports the idea that more generated tests are automatically better.
  • Appendices D and E give the role prompts and clarify the hard gate/global memory, but numeric values for every symbolic threshold or capacity are not fully specified in the paper. Reproduction should also capture command-line settings because repository class fallbacks differ.
  • The official release is code-only. Its runtime guards are reliability controls rather than a security boundary, and no stable generated counterexample corpus or record-level lineage was found; canonical status remains partial and curation level L3_summary_ready.

• 应把第 3.3–3.6 节连起来读：贡献是 Solver、Attacker、Arbiter、全局测试记忆与最终重排组成的反馈闭环，不是某个孤立组件。
  • 区分三类信号：公开测试通过率是 Solver 奖励，输出分歧是 Attacker 奖励，Arbiter 提供测试有效性与期望输出；三者都不等于隐藏测试正确性。
  • 表 1 说明任务层面的提升；若关注验证器数据质量，表 3 与图 7 更关键，因为它们直接测量标签有效性与判别错误。
  • 附录 C.1 是展示弱验证代价的 oracle 诊断，附录 C.3 则说明增加 Attacker 算力可能使结果变差；二者都不支持“测试越多越好”。
  • 附录 D 给出各角色 prompt，附录 E 澄清硬准入与全局记忆，但论文没有完整给出所有符号化阈值/容量；复现还应记录命令行设置，因为仓库的 class fallback 并不一致。
  • 官方只发布代码。其 runtime guard 是可靠性控制而非安全边界，也没有发现稳定的生成反例语料或逐记录 lineage；canonical status 保持 partial，curation level 保持 L3_summary_ready。

value.html: Generated Python programs are executed against APPS or TACO tests. At inspected commit f45427800a32dc6966429bc4f7baf61df5c6a15f, the released executor launches a subprocess, applies an 11-second in-process alarm, a 15-second parent-side monitor, a 10 MB captured-output cap, a 4 GiB address/data/stack rlimit and a reliability guard that disables selected destructive/process operations. It provides no container, namespace, seccomp or documented network isolation and is not a security boundary for arbitrary untrusted code.

value_zh.html: 生成的 Python 程序在 APPS 或 TACO 测试上执行。在所检查的 commit f45427800a32dc6966429bc4f7baf61df5c6a15f，已发布的执行器启动 subprocess，施加 11-second 进程内 alarm、15-second 父侧监视器、10 MB 捕获输出上限、4 GiB address/data/stack rlimit，以及禁用所选破坏性/进程操作的可靠性保护。它不提供 container、namespace、seccomp 或已文档化的网络隔离，且不是针对任意不可信代码的安全边界。

value.html: Public-test pass rate supplies intrinsic Solver reward. The Attacker receives an output-divergence reward over the accepted code pool. A same-backbone LLM Arbiter reads the specification, generated input and divergent outputs, discards tests it judges ambiguous or invalid, and labels accepted tests; failures on the growing global test suite produce Solver penalties and hard admission/reranking constraints.

value_zh.html: 公开测试通过率提供内在 Solver 奖励。Attacker 在已接受代码池上获得输出分歧奖励。同一骨干的 LLM Arbiter 阅读规格、生成输入与分歧输出，丢弃其判定为歧义或无效的测试，并对已接受测试打标签；在不断增长的全局测试套件上的失败产生 Solver 惩罚与硬准入/重排序约束。

value.html: Hierarchically rank generated programs first by public-test pass rate and then by pass rate on all accumulated adversarial tests, selecting the highest-ranked program. Hidden tests are reserved for evaluation and are not available to the inference procedure.

value_zh.html: 按层次对生成程序排序：先按公开测试通过率，再按全部累积对抗测试通过率，选择排名最高的程序。隐藏测试保留用于评测，推理过程不可用。

value.html: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 and Qwen3-8B non-instruct are the main backbones; DeepSeek-V3.2 671B appears in the backbone-scaling experiment.

value_zh.html: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 与 Qwen3-8B non-instruct 是主要骨干；DeepSeek-V3.2 671B 出现在骨干扩展实验中。

value.html: No separate teacher is used. The selected backbone is reused as Solver, Attacker and LLM output Arbiter; therefore the adversarial labels are self-judged rather than supplied by an independent oracle.

value_zh.html: 不使用单独的教师模型。所选骨干被复用为 Solver、Attacker 与 LLM 输出 Arbiter；因此对抗标签为自我判定，而非由独立 oracle 提供。

value.html: A persistent Solver MCTS searches over partial chain-of-thought nodes and rolls each expanded thought into a complete program. A persistent Attacker MCTS searches over abstract vulnerability strategies and uses divergence-driven multi-sample test synthesis conditioned on the evolving code pool.

value_zh.html: 持久 Solver MCTS 在部分思维链节点上搜索，并将每个展开的思考 rollout 为完整程序。持久 Attacker MCTS 在抽象漏洞策略上搜索，并基于演化中的代码池使用分歧驱动的多样本测试合成。

value.html: Main experiments use 16 Solver rollouts and 2 Attacker rollouts per interaction with maximum tree width 3. The released driver/README use five generated test candidates in the DMTS batch and a small accepted code pool, but exact paper-version capacity and every generation setting are not fully specified in the paper.

value_zh.html: 主实验每次交互使用 16 条 Solver rollout 与 2 条 Attacker rollout，最大树宽 3。已发布的 driver/README 在 DMTS batch 中使用五个生成测试候选及较小的已接受代码池，但精确的论文版本容量与每项生成设置在论文中未完全说明。

value.html: The released implementation sets DMTS test-input sampling to 0.7 and the LLM Arbiter to 0.0. The paper reports 0.7 for Best-of-N, but a complete paper-version decoding-temperature contract for every Solver and Attacker call remains unknown.

value_zh.html: 已发布实现将 DMTS 测试输入采样设为 0.7、LLM Arbiter 设为 0.0。论文报告 Best-of-N 为 0.7，但针对每次 Solver 与 Attacker 调用的完整论文版本解码温度约定仍未知。

value.html: A program enters the shared pool only if it passes every public test and every previously retained adversarial test. A generated input is retained only after it causes output divergence and the Arbiter supplies a non-null expected output; retained input-output pairs become hard gates for future programs and secondary criteria in final reranking.

value_zh.html: 程序仅在通过每个公开测试与每个先前保留的对抗测试后进入共享池。生成的输入仅在导致输出分歧且 Arbiter 提供非空期望输出后保留；保留的输入-输出对成为未来程序的硬门控，以及最终重排序的次级准则。

value.html: Main results use 16 Solver rollouts and 2 Attacker rollouts per interaction. The attacker-budget study varies 1 to 4 rollouts and finds an inverted-U trend; APPS-Competition Pass@1 rises from 31% at one attacker rollout to 36% at two, then larger budgets can saturate or hurt. Exact token totals, wall-clock cost, hardware allocation and per-problem dollar cost are unknown.

value_zh.html: 主结果每次交互使用 16 条 Solver rollout 与 2 条 Attacker rollout。攻击者预算研究在 1 至 4 条 rollout 间变化并发现倒 U 趋势；APPS-Competition Pass@1 从一条 attacker rollout 时的 31% 升至两条时的 36%，更大预算可能饱和或损害。精确 token 总量、墙钟成本、硬件分配与每题美元成本未知。

value.html: Dual UCB-guided MCTS with a persistent Solver thought tree, persistent Attacker strategy tree, dynamic accepted code pool, divergence-driven test synthesis, an LLM Global Filtering Hub, penalty backpropagation and hard test-based reranking. This is inference-time search, not a parameter-training optimizer.

value_zh.html: 双 UCB 引导的 MCTS，含持久 Solver 思考树、持久 Attacker 策略树、动态已接受代码池、分歧驱动测试合成、LLM Global Filtering Hub、惩罚反向传播与基于硬测试的重排序。这是推理时搜索，而非参数训练优化器。

value.html: The reported evaluation samples 100 problems from each of three APPS and three TACO difficulty splits, for 600 benchmark problems in total. The method generates transient programs, test strategies and adversarial tests separately for each problem; it does not release these generated traces or tests as a reusable dataset.

value_zh.html: 所报告评测从三个 APPS 与三个 TACO 难度划分各采样 100 题，共 600 道基准问题。该方法为每题分别生成瞬时程序、测试策略与对抗测试；不将这些生成轨迹或测试作为可复用数据集发布。

value.html: APPS Introductory, Interview and Competition and TACO Easy, Medium and Hard are evaluated with up to five visible public tests per problem; hidden tests determine pass rate and Pass@1. The exact sampled problem identifiers and a deterministic split manifest are not released in the inspected repository.

value_zh.html: APPS Introductory、Interview 与 Competition 以及 TACO Easy、Medium 与 Hard 以每题至多五个可见公开测试评测；隐藏测试决定通过率与 Pass@1。精确采样的问题标识符与确定性划分清单在所检查仓库中未发布。

value.html: unknown. The paper does not report exact-match, near-duplicate or semantic-overlap checks between the evaluated APPS/TACO problems and the pretraining or instruction data of Qwen3 or DeepSeek-V3.2.

value_zh.html: 未知。论文未报告所评测 APPS/TACO 题目与 Qwen3 或 DeepSeek-V3.2 的预训练或指令数据之间的 exact-match、近重复或语义重叠检查。

items: Output divergence cannot detect a shared logical error when every candidate emits the same wrong output; the paper states this limitation explicitly.

The same backbone adjudicates its own generated tests. On TACO, Arbiter-labeled test validity measured against gold code is 79.88%, leaving a material measured invalid-label rate despite outperforming majority voting at 37.88%.

A wrongly adjudicated test becomes a persistent hard constraint for the remainder of that problem. No explicit deduplication, repeated revalidation, confidence calibration, correction or test-retraction loop was found in the released implementation.
No explicit repeated-execution or flakiness screen was found. A nondeterministic candidate or environment can therefore create unstable divergence or expected-output evidence.
Larger Attacker budgets can over-optimize disagreement and produce brittle or borderline-valid tests; the paper reports an inverted-U trend from one to four attacker rollouts.
The reported discriminator analysis has 56.7% recall, 78.95% precision and 16.1% false-positive rate, so many silent bugs remain undetected and some truly correct programs are wrongfully penalized.
Hidden tests are used only for retrospective evaluation; inference-time correctness still depends on sparse public tests, code-pool diversity and fallible Arbiter judgments.

The released execution layer is a subprocess reliability wrapper rather than a security sandbox. Although the inspected code sets a 4 GiB rlimit plus time and output caps, it lacks container, namespace, seccomp and documented network isolation and should not be treated as safe for arbitrary untrusted code.
The exact benchmark sample IDs, complete seeds/configuration, immutable release, dependency lockfile and full cost/hardware accounting are not published, limiting exact reproduction.

The repository releases code but no generated adversarial tests, code pools, search trees, per-test decisions, invalid-test ledger or benchmark result bundle, so the claimed dynamic data-construction process cannot be audited record by record.

The official code repository has no explicit license, and separately downloaded APPS/TACO data retain their own upstream terms; the paper's CC BY 4.0 license does not license the implementation or benchmark data.
当所有候选发出相同的错误输出时，输出分歧无法检测共享逻辑错误；论文明确陈述了这一局限。
同一骨干裁定其自身生成的测试。在 TACO 上，以标准答案代码衡量的 Arbiter 标注测试有效性为 79.88%，尽管优于多数投票的 37.88%，仍留下可观的实测无效标签率。
错误裁定的测试会成为该题目剩余过程中的持久硬约束。已发布实现中未发现显式去重、重复再核验、置信度校准、纠正或测试撤回循环。
未发现显式的重复执行或 flakiness 筛查。因此非确定性候选或环境可产生不稳定的分歧或期望输出证据。
更大的 Attacker 预算可能过度优化分歧并产生脆弱或边界有效的测试；论文报告了从一次到四次 attacker rollout 的倒 U 型趋势。
所报告的判别器分析具有 56.7% recall、78.95% precision 和 16.1% 假阳性率，因此许多静默缺陷仍未被检出，且部分真正正确的程序被错误惩罚。
隐藏测试仅用于回溯评测；推理时正确性仍依赖于稀疏公开测试、代码池多样性及可能出错的 Arbiter 判断。
已发布的执行层是 subprocess 可靠性包装器而非安全沙箱。虽经检查的代码设置了 4 GiB rlimit 以及时间和输出上限，但缺少 container、namespace、seccomp 和已文档化的网络隔离，不应视为对任意不可信代码安全。
精确的基准样本 ID、完整种子/配置、不可变发布、依赖 lockfile 以及完整成本/硬件核算均未发布，限制了精确复现。
仓库发布了代码，但未发布生成的对抗测试、代码池、搜索树、逐测试决策、无效测试台账或基准结果包，因此所声称的动态数据构建过程无法逐条审计。
官方代码仓库无显式许可，单独下载的 APPS/TACO 数据保留其自身上游条款；论文的 CC BY 4.0 许可并不授权实现或基准数据。

value.html: For each benchmark problem, public-test-passing Solver programs populate a bounded code pool. The persistent Attacker tree generates code-pool-conditioned inputs; divergent executions are sent to the same-backbone Arbiter, and accepted input-output pairs are appended to problem-local dynamic test memory. These tests gate later pool admission, penalize originating Solver nodes and rerank final candidates. The memory is reset for the next problem and is not published with stable test IDs, generation prompts, per-test provenance or rejection records.

value_zh.html: 对每个基准题目，通过公开测试的 Solver 程序填充有界代码池。持久 Attacker 树生成以代码池为条件的输入；分歧执行被送至同一骨干的 Arbiter，被接受的输入-输出对被追加到题目本地的动态测试记忆。这些测试门控后续入池、惩罚源 Solver 节点并重排最终候选。该记忆在下一题目时重置，且不以稳定测试 ID、生成提示、逐测试溯源或拒绝记录的形式公开发布。
